name: Botanical Natural Monument “Bobruisk Giant Oak”
categoryName: Botanical Natural Monument of local significance
shortDesc: The giant oak at the intersection of Gogol and Chongarskaya Streets is a Bobruisk old-timer more than three hundred years old.
fullDesc:
📍 LOCATION:
Bobruisk, intersection of Gogol and Chongarskaya Streets, near the Bobruisk Fortress.

📌 STATUS AND HISTORY:
In 2003 the tree was declared a botanical natural monument of local significance. It is more than three hundred years old.

🌿 FEATURES:
Trunk diameter — 1.4 m; height — 28 m. The crown extends 17.1 m north–south and 24.2 m east–west. The presentation separately notes the importance of crown wind load.

sources.title: Удодов, А. «Дуб-великан» // Магілёўскія ведамасцi. — 2001. — 6 ноября. — С. 4.

name: Landscape Reserve “Lukovaya Gora”
shortDesc: A section of the right bank of the Berezina River on the northern edge of Bobruisk, between the sixth microdistrict and the Berezina settlement. Area — 30.5 ha.
fullDesc:
📍 LOCATION:
Bobruisk, Berezina settlement; a section of the right bank of the Berezina River on the northern edge of the city.

📌 STATUS AND HISTORY:
The reserve was established in 1994 to preserve characteristic landforms of the Central Berezina glacial-water plain and its rich flora and fauna.

🏞 FEATURES:
Length — about 1,000 m; area — 30.5 ha. The slope rises about 30 m above the floodplain.

🌍 GEOLOGY:
The local landscape was shaped by glaciofluvial deposits of the Dnieper and Sozh glaciations; modern river activity can also be observed.

sources.title: Голубева, Т. «Луковая гора» // Бабруйскае жыццё. — 2009. — 1 июля. — С. 10.

name: Landscape Reserve “Dubovski Cascade of Lakes”
shortDesc: A unique landscape of the Vir River valley: over 14 km the river connects four lakes — Dragochin, Usokh, Plavun and Vyakhovo.
fullDesc:
📍 LOCATION:
Bobruisk District, Priberezinskoye forestry of Bobruisk Forestry Enterprise, 4 km west of Telusha agro-town. Area — 191 ha.

📌 STATUS AND HISTORY:
Established in 1994 to protect unique natural landscapes of the Vir River valley.

💧 CASCADE OF LAKES:
Over 14 km from north to south, the Vir River connects four lakes — Dragochin, Usokh, Plavun and Vyakhovo. The presentation notes that this phenomenon is unique in Mogilev Region.

🌿 NATURAL VALUE:
The reserve contains habitats of rare animal and plant species listed in the Red Book of Belarus and the International Red Book of the World Conservation Union.

sources.title: Вербицкий, Е. «Есть чем удивить» // Белорусская лесная газета. — 2014. — 24 апреля. — С. 7.

name: Botanical Natural Monument “Century Pine”
categoryName: Botanical Natural Monument of local significance
shortDesc: An old-growth pine in the Berezina valley, about 4.4 km southeast of Mikhailovka village. Age — 200–250 years.
fullDesc:
📍 LOCATION:
Bobruisk District, 4.4 km southeast of Mikhailovka village, Gorbacevichi rural council.

📌 STATUS AND HISTORY:
The monument was approved in 2014 to preserve the local gene pool and has scientific, aesthetic and educational value.

🌲 FEATURES:
The giant pine grows in a 1.5 ha oak stand. The age of the oak and pine is 200–250 years. Trunk diameter at 1.3 m — 370 cm; total height — 35.2 m. The bark resembles scales.

🌳 SURROUNDINGS:
Another very old pine and several large oaks grow nearby.

sources.title: Гладкова, Е. «Древняя сосна получила статус» // Трыбуна працы (Бабруйск). — 2015. — 4 февраля. — С. 4.

name: Botanical Natural Monument “Floodplain Oak Forest”
categoryName: Botanical Natural Monument of local significance
shortDesc: Part of a forest massif in the Berezina floodplain covering 629 ha, created to preserve old and rare tree species.
fullDesc:
📍 LOCATION:
Bobruisk District, 10 km south of Bobruisk and 0.6 km southwest of Domanovo village, in Domanovo forestry of Bobruisk Forestry Enterprise.

📌 STATUS AND PURPOSE:
“Floodplain Oak Forest” is a botanical natural monument of local significance. Area — 629 ha. It was created to preserve old and rare tree species and their groups.

🌳 TREE STANDS:
Oak stands valuable for age and productivity occupy more than half of the area. Trees are 90–100 years old; individual oaks reach 180–200 years. The monument is based in equal parts on floodplain oak forest and meadowsweet black alder forest.

🌿 OTHER FORESTS:
Black alder, pine, birch, spruce, hornbeam and aspen forests also occur here.
